description: This file contains test hooks for setup and teardown in UI automation using SpecFlow with Selenium WebDriver and Allure for reporting. It manages driver creation, cleanup, and attaches screenshots upon test failure.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Contains setup and teardown logic for each test scenario, including screenshot attachment on failure.

methods.name: BeforeScenario
methods.description: Initializes WebDriver before each test scenario.

methods.name: AfterScenario
methods.description: Performs cleanup after each scenario, attaches screenshot on failure.

methods.name: TryAddAllureAttachment
methods.description: Helper method to add an attachment to Allure report, handling exceptions silently.
